# ztna_connector_upgrade_status (Data Source)

Get Connector Scheduled Upgrade Status



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oid` (String) Parent connector OID.

### Read-Only

- `active_image_id` (String) Currently active image ID
- `active_version` (String) Currently active software version
- `download_percent` (Number) Download progress percentage
- `failure_info` (String) Failure information if upgrade failed
- `previous_image_id` (String) Previous image ID
- `scheduled_download` (String) Scheduled download time
- `scheduled_upgrade` (String) Scheduled upgrade time
- `tfid` (String)
- `upgrade_description` (String) Description of the upgrade
- `upgrade_image_id` (String) Target upgrade image ID
- `upgrade_state` (String) Current state of the upgrade process
